name: zSwap
description: An entirely onchain exchange for swaps, orders, token launches, and payments. Send ETH or tokens to .gwei names with shareable links and optional reversible timelocks.

name: Kohaku CLI
description: A terminal wallet for public and private Ethereum balances. Resolve, register, renew, transfer, and manage .gwei names from the command line.

name: micro-eth-signer
description: A minimal, privacy-focused Ethereum library for signing and RPC data. Resolve and reverse-resolve .gwei names, read records, and check availability, expiries, and fees.

name: Rebloom
description: A minimal web app for renewing Ethereum names. Renew .gwei names for one or more years in a single transaction.

name: multisig.software
description: A multichain multisig wallet with an embedded timelock. Use .gwei names for vaults, owners, and transaction recipients.

name: Ambire
description: A self-custodial smart wallet for Ethereum and EVM networks. Resolve .gwei names when sending and see GNS identities throughout the wallet.

name: MetaMask Snap
description: Add GNS resolution to MetaMask. Send to .gwei names and reverse-resolve wallet addresses to forward-confirmed primary names on Ethereum mainnet and Sepolia.

name: gwei.site
description: An edge gateway for decentralized websites on IPFS, IPNS, and Swarm. Open any .gwei site at <name>.gwei.site, or map it to a custom domain.

name: request-wallet-sign
description: A local signing bridge that lets AI agents hand transactions to your browser wallet without seeing your private key. Use a .gwei name as the recipient and it resolves before you sign.

name: DefiLlama
description: An open DeFi analytics platform for TVL, fees, revenue, and more. Track .gwei registration and renewal fees on Ethereum.

name: Snapshot
description: A voting platform for DAOs, DeFi protocols, and NFT communities, with flexible governance and no gas fees. Use .gwei names across proposals, votes, delegates, and transactions.

name: POIDH
description: A social bounty platform with collectible NFTs on Arbitrum, Base, and Degen Chain. It displays .gwei names across profiles, leaderboards, bounties, and shared posts.

name: holders.vote
description: A signal-boosting consensus finding tool for token weighted communities to share information and prioritize. Uses .gwei names as moderated and contextualized namespaces as well as user identity.

name: ENS to GNS Migrator
description: Register a .gwei name and migrate your ENS identity across to it, including your website, avatar, and primary name records.

name: ethereum-names
description: A developer library with one clean API to resolve Ethereum names across ENS, the Gwei Name Service, and the Wei Name Service, powered by viem. Point it at a .gwei name or an address and it resolves in a single call.

name: Cleave
description: A decentralized options exchange on Ethereum. Write and trade options that can't be liquidated, with no margin calls or forced closes. It resolves addresses to their .gwei name, preferring it over .eth when both are set.

name: Freedom
description: A minimalist desktop browser for Swarm and IPFS. Type a .gwei (and .eth) name, hash, or CID straight into the bar and connect to peers directly. No public gateway, no DNS in the middle.

name: Kao
description: A cute, secure desktop wallet for Ethereum, built in pure Rust with no telemetry. Resolve, register, and manage .gwei names from its Names app, all verified by a Helios light client.

name: WalletChan
description: A browser wallet extension for using your Bankr address across every dapp, like MetaMask. Send to .gwei (and .eth) names, and look them up in its built-in name browser.

name: dapp3
description: A browser extension for opening .gwei (and .eth) sites like any other website, verified locally. It resolves names against Ethereum with a Helios light client and serves them from your own IPFS node. No public gateway, no hijackable DNS, nothing to trust in the middle.
